meta.title: Memory Bridge
meta.description: Gives every session, on any model, the project's shared memory: the MEMORY.md index Claude Code keeps, and a memory tool that lists, reads, saves and deletes notes in the same plain-Markdown format, so every agent shares one memory. The protocol rides in the system prompt, so it works with any model. Also loads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules. Type /memory to see what was found.
